title: Polynomial identification of the inverted desingularization quotient
statement: Let R be a commutative ring, A an R-algebra with finite presentation P=R[x_1,...,x_n]/(f_1,...,f_m) [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra], pi∈R and c≤m. Let s_ik∈R and g_j∈Q=R[v_1,...,v_c,w_1,...,w_n] [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring]. Put xi_i=pi^2 sum_k s_ik v_k+pi^3 w_i, F_j=f_j(xi), G=(g), S=Q/G and K the image of (F) in S. If F_j=pi^3 g_j for j<c, then (S/K)_pi is R-algebra isomorphic to A_pi[v_1,...,v_c]. All polynomial variable index sets may be universe lifted.

source.place: Stacks Project, Smoothing Ring Maps, proof of Lemma Tag 07CR (lemma-desingularize)

proof.text: Put I=(f_j(xi)), J=(g_j), T=(Q/I)_pi and let a:Q→T be the composite of quotient and localization. For j<c, applying a to f_j(xi)=pi^3 g_j gives a(pi)^3 a(g_j)=0. The image of pi is a unit in T, so a(g_j)=0. Hence J is contained in the kernel of a.

The map a factors through Q/J and then through D=(Q/J)/map(I), since it kills I. Inverting pi gives a map D_pi→T. Conversely the composite Q→D→D_pi kills I and gives T→D_pi. The composites are the identities: use localization extensionality, quotient extensionality, and agreement on Q. This is the private proved helper remove_redundant_localized_relations; no localization-quotient commutation theorem is used.

More generally set xi_i=t_i(v)+pi^d w_i. Construct a map A→(Q/I)_pi by factoring evaluation x_i↦xi_i through the kernel of the presentation; then extend it to A_pi. Together with v_k↦v_k this gives back:A_pi[v]→(Q/I)_pi. Define theta:Q→A_pi[v] by v_k↦v_k and w_i↦pi^(-d)(x_i-t_i(v)). Its value on xi_i is x_i, so every substituted presentation relation vanishes. Theta therefore extends to forward:(Q/I)_pi→A_pi[v].

Forward composed with back fixes A: check the presentation generators, then use surjectivity of the presentation evaluation. It fixes A_pi by localization extensionality and fixes every v_k, so it is the identity. Back composed with forward fixes every v_k. On w_i, use back(x_i)=xi_i and back(t_i(v))=t_i(v) to obtain pi^(-d)(xi_i-t_i(v))=w_i. Quotient and localization extensionality give the identity everywhere. These computations are the private proved helper localized_affine_presentation_quotient_equiv. Specialize d=3 and t_i=pi^2 sum_k s_ik v_k, and compose with the redundant-relation equivalence. All maps are R-algebra maps; no nontriviality or nonempty-index hypothesis is used.

proof_origin.place: Stacks Project, proof of Lemma Tag 07CR (lemma-desingularize), equations h_i and identification B_pi ≅ A_pi[v]; explicit inverse maps formalized by K2.

from.place: Polynomial construction and inverted-quotient steps of the desingularization argument used in step 7 of finite-etale lifting

lean.statement: theorem desingularization_inverted_quotient_equiv (R : Type u) (A : Type w) [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] (π : R) (n m c : ℕ) (P : Presentation R A (Fin n) (Fin m)) (hc : c ≤ m) (s : Fin n → Fin c → R) (g : Fin c → MvPolynomial (ULift.{w} (Fin c ⊕ Fin n)) R) (hg : ∀ j : Fin c, aeval (R := R) (fun i : Fin n ↦ C π ^ 2 * ∑ k, C (s i k) * X (σ := ULift.{w} (Fin c ⊕ Fin n)) (ULift.up (Sum.inl k)) + C π ^ 3 * X (σ := ULift.{w} (Fin c ⊕ Fin n)) (ULift.up (Sum.inr i))) (P.relation (Fin.castLE hc j)) = C π ^ 3 * g j) : let Q := MvPolynomial (ULift.{w} (Fin c ⊕ Fin n)) R let ξ : Fin n → Q := fun i ↦ C π ^ 2 * ∑ k, C (s i k) * X (ULift.up (Sum.inl k)) + C π ^ 3 * X (ULift.up (Sum.inr i)) let S := Q ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range g) let K := Ideal.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (Set.range g))) (Ideal.span (Set.range (fun j : Fin m ↦ aeval (R := R) ξ (P.relation j)))) Nonempty (Localization.Away (algebraMap R (S ⧸ K) π) ≃ₐ[R] MvPolynomial (Fin c) (Localization.Away (algebraMap R A π)))
